I would appreciate it if you could help me diagnose the root cause of this memory leak. Some things to consider are:
1. Are there any memory-intensive operations being performed by the billing service? If so, could they be contributing to the memory leak?
2. Is there any caching mechanism being used by the billing service that could be causing the memory leak? If so, could we optimize or disable it?
3. Are there any memory leaks in the third-party libraries or frameworks being used by the billing service? If so, could we investigate and potentially update them?
4. Is there any logging or monitoring in place to track memory usage over time? If so, could we analyze the logs to identify patterns or trends that could help us diagnose the issue?
I would like to work with you to investigate this issue and come up with a plan to resolve it. Please let me know if you have any questions or if there is anything else I can provide to assist you.
Thank you for your time and attention to this matter.
Best regards, [Your Name]
